# Colby Davis — Personal Landing Page

*Replace this heading with your project name if reusing this template.*

## Description

*2–4 sentences describing what the project does, who it is for, and why it exists.*

A single-page professional landing page built for Colby Davis, a Business Analytics and Finance student at the University of Iowa. The site is designed to help recruiters quickly evaluate his technical skills, project experience, and leadership background in a clean, recruiter-friendly format. It serves as a centralized hub linking to his LinkedIn profile and downloadable resume, aimed at improving his chances of securing internships and entry-level analyst roles in finance, consulting, and business intelligence.

## Features

*Replace with the features of your specific project.*

- **Sticky navigation bar** — smooth anchor-link scrolling to every section of the page
- **Professional hero section** — circular headshot, value proposition tagline, and prominent LinkedIn and resume download CTAs
- **Three-project portfolio** — each card displays tools used, real bullet-point outcomes, and dates
- **Grouped skill badges** — pill-shaped tags organized by category (Financial & Data Tools and Programming)
- **Experience & Leadership timeline** — covers work experience, fraternity finance leadership, club sports, and international study abroad
- **One-click resume download** — PDF linked directly from both the hero and the dedicated resume section
- **HTML contact form** — name, email, and message fields alongside labeled email, LinkedIn, and GitHub icon links
- **Fully responsive design** — single-column mobile layout scaling from 320 px up to full desktop

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

*List what needs to be installed before running the project.*

- A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- No package manager, build tool, or runtime is required — this is a static site

### Installation

*Numbered steps to clone and run locally.*

1. Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/colbydavis13/mod-8-landing-page.git
```

2. Navigate into the project folder:

```bash
cd mod-8-landing-page
```

3. Open the site in your browser. You can either:
   - Double-click `index.html` to open it directly, **or**
   - Serve it locally with Python for accurate relative-path resolution:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Then visit `http://localhost:8000` in your browser.

## Usage

*Describe how to use the application once running.*

Open `index.html` in a browser (or visit the live URL). Use the sticky navigation bar to jump between sections — About, Projects, Skills, Experience, Resume, and Contact. Click **View LinkedIn** to open Colby's LinkedIn profile in a new tab, or **Download Resume** to save the PDF. The contact form accepts a name, email, and message (note: the form is static HTML and does not submit data without a backend or form service).

## Changelog

*Update this section each time you release a new version.*

### v1.0.0 — March 23, 2026

- Initial release of the complete single-page landing page
- Hero section with circular headshot, tagline, LinkedIn CTA, and resume download
- About Me section with dual-degree education details, GPA 3.80, and academic awards
- Projects section: Web-Based Movie Analytics Application, Marketplace Bicycle Simulation, Multi-Dataset Regression Analysis
- Skills section with pill-badge groupings for Financial & Data Tools and Programming
- Experience & Leadership section covering work history, Delta Tau Delta finance roles, Iowa Men's Club Soccer, and CIMBA Study Abroad
- Resume section with PDF download button
- Contact section with labeled icon links and HTML contact form
- Fully responsive layout (320 px and up), WCAG 2.2 AA compliant, validated with Nu HTML Checker

## Known Issues / To-Do

*Check these off as you complete them, or add your own items.*

- [ ] Contact form does not submit — a form service (e.g., Formspree) or backend endpoint is needed to make it functional
- [ ] No dark mode support — a `prefers-color-scheme` media query could be added
- [ ] Resume PDF is committed to the repository, increasing repo size — a cloud storage link (e.g., Google Drive) would be cleaner long-term
- [ ] No favicon — a small browser tab icon has not yet been added
- [ ] Full Lighthouse accessibility audit not yet completed — some WCAG gaps may remain

## Roadmap

*Features or improvements planned for a hypothetical future version.*

- **Dark mode toggle** — a CSS variable-based theme switch with a persistent `localStorage` preference
- **Functional contact form** — integrate Formspree or a similar static-form service so recruiters can send messages without a backend
- **GitHub Projects widget** — pull and display pinned GitHub repositories dynamically using the GitHub API
- **Micro-animations** — subtle scroll-triggered fade-ins on section cards using the Intersection Observer API
- **Custom domain** — connect a personal domain for a more professional public URL
